This preview does not award credits or promise a completion date or complete degree price.

TESU’s transfer rules

  • Up to 105 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 120-credit degree.
  • At least 15 semester credits must be completed at TESU.
  • At least 18 semester credits must be upper-level.
  • TESU caps alternative credit at 90 semester credits.

Source: TESU tuition effective August 2026: standard rates, flat-rate eligibility and qualifying residency methods · TESU current General Management curriculum: 120 credits and 15 free-elective credits · TESU current transfer credit policy: caps, duplicate awards and grade minima · TESU noncollegiate combined-credit limit clarification

Questions

Does Study.com Business 308: Globalization & International Management transfer to Thomas Edison State University?

Study.com publishes this match: Study.com Business 308: Globalization & International Management for MAN-3720 International Management (3 semester credits). The match does not come from TESU, so ask TESU to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com Business 306: Strategic Human Resource Management transfer to Thomas Edison State University?

Study.com publishes this match: Study.com Business 306: Strategic Human Resource Management for MAN-3310 Human Resources Management (3 semester credits). The match does not come from TESU, so ask TESU to confirm it before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Thomas Edison State University’s B.S. in General Management?

TESU’s published limit for this 120-credit degree is 105 semester credits from other sources. At least 15 semester credits must be completed at TESU. This plan proposes 90 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Thomas Edison State University?

In this plan, 30 semester credits are taken at TESU, including SOS-1100 Fact, Fiction, or Fake? Information Literacy Today and BUS-4210 Business Administration Capstone. TESU requires at least 15 semester credits at TESU.

Has Thomas Edison State University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need TESU’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school for a written transfer evaluation that confirms these courses for your catalog year, including any major-course residency rules. Ask the school to confirm 25 proposed course matches for this exact program before paying for them. Check the provider’s current enrollment terms for 5 outside courses before you enroll. Ask the school which catalog year applies to you. Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always TESU’s decisions.
